high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "akanksha.chouudhary." The post shows a person standing in shallow, clear water at a beach. The individual is wearing a white off-the-shoulder crop top with lace detailing and a matching white skirt that has a corset-like lacing on the front. They also have a headband with a floral pattern and are accessorized with a gold necklace and bracelets. The background features a calm ocean with gentle waves and a clear blue sky, suggesting a serene and sunny day. There are a few small buoys floating in the water behind the person
